> **Notice:** Please review `SECURITY.md` in the repository root before filing. Do not upload copyrighted ROMs, keys, or security vulnerabilities in public issues.

## Summary

A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Launch mode (e.g., Windows `OcarinaAtlas.exe`, Linux `OcarinaAtlas-Linux-x64.AppImage`, or `npm run dev`)
2. Open your emulator or PC recomp (Lichii / Fritchii / CheezyEmu / Longshot / Project ReLink / Triforce / HeyListen / NX2Saria / OOT-PC / NX2navi) and load Ocarina of Time (`0400486024DEC000`)
3. Enter area / floor / action taken
4. Observe the issue

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened (include any error messages, toast notifications, or status bar text such as `Live`, `Waiting for game`, `Save only`, or `Disconnected`).

## Telemetry Output (Optional)

If possible, paste the sanitized JSON response from `http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/lichii/state` (or your configured `PORT`).

```json

```

- **Game Title ID:** `0400486024DEC000`
